BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                OF THE STATE OF MISSOURI


   In the Matter of Union Electric Company         )
   d/b/a Ameren Missouri’s Tariff to Adjust its    )      Case No. ER-2026-0291
   Revenues for Electric Service                   )




      ORDER GRANTING AMENDED MOTION FOR PROTECTIVE ORDER

Issue Date: September 28, 2026                          Effective Date: September 28, 2026

       On September 11, 2026, Union Electric Company d/b/a Ameren Missouri filed an

Amended Motion for Protective Order. Commission Rule 20 CSR 4240-2.080(13) allows

parties ten days to respond to pleadings unless otherwise ordered by the Commission. The

Commission issued no order to the contrary, more than ten days have passed since the

Motion was filed, and no one has responded. Thus, the Commission will take up the Motion

unopposed.

       Ameren Missouri states that there is certain information in its direct case filing, and

information that may, or likely will, be the subject of discovery requests that should not be

available to employees of any non-state agency entities not covered by statutory

confidentiality requirements who may become parties to this case. Consequently, Ameren

Missouri seeks a protective order allowing it to designate such information as "Highly

Confidential" under 20 CSR 4240-2.135(4). Also, Ameren Missouri seeks a protective order

allowing it to designate information and agreements between Ameren Missouri and

prospective or actual customers who would take service under its Large Load Customer
 Service ("LLCS") Service Classification and associated tariff schedules and riders as Highly

Confidential.

       Ameren Missouri requests that the Commission direct use in this docket of the form

marked as Exhibit A thereto for those persons who will be authorized to access

"Confidential" information. Further, Ameren Missouri requests that the Commission direct

use in this docket of the form marked as Exhibit B thereto for those persons who will be

authorized to access "Highly Confidential" information.

       After considering the unopposed Motion, the Commission finds that Ameren

Missouri’s request is reasonable. The Commission grants the Motion.

       THE COMMISSION ORDERS THAT:

       1.       The Amended Motion for Protective Order is granted.

       2.       Parties shall use the Non-Disclosure Agreement forms marked as Exhibits A

and B attached to Ameren Missouri’s Motion.

       3.       This order is effective when issued.



                                                   BY THE COMMISSION




                                                   Nancy Dippell
